notes.title: v0.2.4 Update is Live! 🐔⚙️
notes.content:
v0.2.4 Update is Live! 🐔⚙️
Hey Chicken Fans! 🐔

A brand new update for Run Chicken Run is now live! This version brings important improvements to enhance your overall gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new in v0.2.4:

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements:

✅ Fixed several known issues.
⚖️ Adjusted stamina balance — running is now more fair!
🔗 Updated the bug report link so you can easily share any issues with us.

As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable. Reporting bugs helps us make the game even better — thank you for your support!

Have fun and don’t forget to keep running! 🍗💨

notes.title: Demo Version (v0.2.3) Update is Live! 🐔🚀
notes.content:
Here are the v0.2.3 release notes:

🆕 New Feature:
💫 We've now added a star effect on fainting chickens! Now getting stunned looks much more dramatic!


🛠️ Edits and Bug Fixes:


🧱 Fixed wall collision bugs in some scenes.

🏹 Fixed Crossbow ammo bug.

🕴️ Fixed a bug that caused the character to disappear in some situations.

🆘 Added “Unstack” feature for situations where players are stuck.

🐞 Fixed various bugs reported by our community.



Thank you very much to everyone who provided feedback! If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, don't forget to share them with us.



Have fun playing and stay away from the frying pan! 🍳🔥Demo Version (v0.2.3) Update is Live! 🐔🚀

notes.title: 🐔 Run Chicken Run is coming to Steam Next Fest! (June 9–16)
notes.content:
Hey there, chaos lovers! 🎉

Our absurd TPS multiplayer game Run Chicken Run will be part of Steam Next Fest from June 9 to 16 – and the demo will be live and FREE to play during the entire event!

You’re not ready for this madness... or maybe you are:

🎤 You are a chicken. You bawk bawk into the mic to escape.

Yes, it’s real. And yes, it works. 🐔💨


🎮 What’s the game about?
• Play as a terrified chicken growing bigger every minute.
• Or become one of 5 angry farmers chasing it with nets and pitchforks.
• Hit the chicken mid-air to stop it.
• Slap your teammates to steal the chicken if they grab it first!
• If the chicken survives 5 minutes? It jumps the fence and wins.
• If a farmer carries it to the restaurant? It becomes dinner. 🍗


❤️ Want to support us?
⭐ Add the game to your wishlist
💬 Share your feedback after playing the demo
📢 Spread the absurd chaos with your friends!



👨‍🌾 Are you the chicken or the hunter?

🎤 Speak into the mic, take off into the skies.

🤜 Slap your friends.

🍗 Serve chaos, not dinner.

🪶 Run Chicken Run – Let the absurdity begin!
